# Wavin Blog

> > Technical blog covering Wavin's plumbing, heating, and water management solutions including underfloor heating systems, pipe technologies, and sustainable drainage products.

Wavin is a global manufacturer of plastic pipe systems and water management solutions. This blog features installation guides, product launches, case studies, and technical documentation across multiple European and Latin American markets, with focus on brands like Amanco Wavin, Hep₂O, Tigris, and AquaCell.

## Key Topics

- Underfloor heating and climate control systems
- AHC 9000 floor heating control
- Hep₂O plumbing systems
- Tigris press fittings
- AquaCell stormwater management
- PP-RCT polypropylene pipe technology
- Sustainable Urban Drainage Systems (SuDS)
- BIM libraries and Revit integration
- Environmental Product Declarations (EPD)
- PVC and polyethylene pipe systems
- Irrigation systems
- BREEAM certification
- Energy efficiency in buildings
- Recycled materials in water management
- Laboratory testing and quality standards
